verdict.rationale: Drata's API reference documents first-party Risk Registers, Risks, Risk Library, Risk Notes and Risk Documents resources, plus a List Risks endpoint and a Risk Assessment help article, so a risk register does live in the platform. The evidence is only titles and endpoint names, though, so the depth the story asks for is unproven. Missing for 10: documented risk scoring, treatment plans, risk owners, review cycles, explicit risk-to-control linkage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, a real risk register lives in the platform — scored risks, treatment plans, owners, and review cycles tied back to controls
